comment: DESIGN.md §2.1 as data (#2): permissive or weak-copyleft dependencies only. `napkin-tools licenses check` fails on any restored package whose nuspec declares no license, or an SPDX expression outside `allowed`, unless that exact package version is listed under `exceptions` with the license as read and a written justification. A package that declares only a license file or URL always needs an exception: a person reads the text first.

exceptions.license: BSD-3-Clause (the package's LICENSE file: ANGLE Project Authors, three-clause BSD text, read 2026-09-26)
exceptions.justification: Declares a license file, not an expression. The file is the three-clause BSD licence, which the allowlist permits. Ships with the app on Windows.
Declares a license file whose text is the MIT licence. Test-only.
Declares a license file whose text is the MIT licence. Test-only.
Declares a license file whose text is the MIT licence. Test-only.
Declares a license file whose text is the MIT licence. Test-only.
Declares only a URL; the text there is the Apache 2.0 licence. Test-only, pulled in by xunit 2.5.3.

exceptions.license: MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS, MICROSOFT .NET LIBRARY (the package's dotnet_library_license.txt, read 2026-09-26) — proprietary, not on the allowlist
exceptions.justification: Test-only: restored by the xunit 2.5.3 test projects (xunit.assert, xunit.extensibility.*), never referenced by src/ and never shipped. Remove by moving those test projects to xunit v3, as Napkin.App.GuiTests already is.

exceptions.license: MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS, MICROSOFT .NET LIBRARY (the package's dotnet_library_license.txt, identical to NETStandard.Library's, read 2026-09-26) — proprietary, not on the allowlist
exceptions.justification: Test-only, pulled in by NETStandard.Library 1.6.1 above; same reason and the same removal.
